python -c "
import semver

# Test R1: Immutability
vi = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
try:
    vi.major = 2
    print('FAIL: Should raise AttributeError on major assignment')
except AttributeError:
    print('OK: R1 - immutability works')

# Test R2: Iteration
vals = list(vi)
print(f'R2 iteration: {vals}')
assert vals == [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build'], f'Expected [1, 2, 3, alpha, build], got {vals}'
print('OK: R2 - iteration works')

# Test R3: Tuple comparison
print(f'R3 tuple compare eq: {vi == (1, 2, 3, \"alpha\", \"build\")}')
print(f'R3 tuple compare lt: {vi < (2, 0, 0)}')
try:
    vi == '1.2.3'
    print('FAIL: Should return NotImplemented or error for string')
except TypeError:
    print('OK: R3 - string comparison raises TypeError')

# Test R4: Bump methods
bumped = vi.bump_major()
print(f'R4 bump_major: {bumped}')
assert bumped.major == 2 and bumped.minor == 0 and bumped.patch == 0
print('OK: R4 - bump methods work')

# Test R5: Type conversion
vi2 = semver.VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', 42, None)
print(f'R5 types: major={type(vi2.major).__name__}, minor={type(vi2.minor).__name__}, patch={type(vi2.patch).__name__}, prerelease={type(vi2.prerelease).__name__}, build={type(vi2.build).__name__}')
assert isinstance(vi2.major, int)
assert isinstance(vi2.prerelease, str)
print('OK: R5 - type conversion works')

# Test R6: CLI functions
print(f'R6 createparser exists: {hasattr(semver, \"createparser\")}')
print(f'R6 main exists: {hasattr(semver, \"main\")}')
print(f'R6 process exists: {hasattr(semver, \"process\")}')

# Test R7: Replace function
new_ver = semver.replace('1.2.3', major=2)
print(f'R7 replace module: {new_ver}')
assert new_ver == '2.2.3'
vi3 = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
new_vi = vi3.replace(minor=5)
print(f'R7 replace method: {new_vi}')
assert new_vi.minor == 5
print('OK: R7 - replace works')

print('\\nAll requirements verified!')
"
